T: Three bad bosses. One good dinner.
D: Three friends with unbearable bosses come up with a very bad plan to get rid of them.
P: Serve the snacks when the three friends start plotting at the bar.
S: Loaded nachos with beef, cheese and sour cream, the bar snack for bad plans. Brown 400g beef mince with taco seasoning.
Soft jam-filled doughnuts rolled in sugar, the one good thing in a horrible office. Warm 8 jam doughnuts in a low oven for 3 minutes and roll in 100g caster sugar.
M: Bacon cheeseburgers with fries, an after work feed. Grill 4 beef patties with cheese and serve in buns with bacon, lettuce and sauce, plus 1kg oven fries.
W: Dark chocolate squares with sea salt. Break 200g dark chocolate into squares and sprinkle with sea salt flakes.
K: Cold lager in schooners. Pour 8 cold bottles of lager into schooners.

s.how: Brown 400g beef mince with taco seasoning. Spread 300g corn chips, top with beef and 200g cheese, bake 10 minutes and finish with sour cream.
Warm 8 jam doughnuts in a low oven for 3 minutes and roll in 100g caster sugar. Serve with 150g extra raspberry jam on the side for dunking.

m.how: Grill 4 beef patties with cheese and serve in buns with bacon, lettuce and sauce, plus 1kg oven fries. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Break 200g dark chocolate into squares and sprinkle with sea salt flakes. Serve it at the halfway point of the film. Leave it out for anyone who wants seconds.

d.how: Pour 8 cold bottles of lager into schooners. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.
